# The sidebar's activity filter (show_tabs, the filter field's button): only
# the tabs whose programs work, wait for you, or finished or failed; the
# name filter on top; the same again, or All Tabs, shows every tab. Rows
# come and go as their programs' states change.
type:printf '\033]2;WORKER\a\033]7501;state=working:app=probe\a'; read x; printf '\033]7501;state=done:app=probe\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
tab:new
type:printf '\033]2;ASKER\a\033]7501;state=blocked:app=probe\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
tab:new
type:printf '\033]2;BREAKER\a\033]7501;state=error:app=probe\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
tab:new
type:printf '\033]2;IDLER\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect-shown:4
action:show_tabs:working
expect-shown:1:WORKER
action:show_tabs:waiting
expect-shown:1:ASKER
action:show_tabs:attention
expect-shown:1:BREAKER
# Again: every tab.
action:show_tabs:attention
expect-shown:4
# The worker finishes: it leaves Working for Finished or Failed.
action:show_tabs:working
expect-shown:1:WORKER
tab:1
key:enter
tab:4
wait:1.0
expect-shown:0
action:show_tabs:attention
expect-shown:2:ER
action:show_tabs:all
expect-shown:4
# A tab changing (a title, a state) doesn't take the keyboard from the
# find bar: the sidebar's update doesn't select the tab again.
tab:new
type:(sleep 1.5; printf '\033]2;RETITLED\a'; sleep 1; printf '\033]7501;state=working:app=probe\a') &
key:enter
wait:0.3
key:cmd+f
wait:3.5
expect-tab:RETITLED
expect-focus:0
key:escape
wait:0.3
expect-focus:1
